title: [ MZ ] Find out enemy DLC packs with character sprites

posts.author: LadyIceheart
posts.body: Heya everyone! Kindly tell me, please, which DLC enemy packs on MZ have not only battlers, but also character sprites? We are interested in any, even with a small number of them (For example, MV Trinity pack/MV enemies character pack on MZ, and others that may include this)

posts.author: fizzly
ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I'm not sure anyone here has looked at and kept track of the contents of every DLC available (even if it's limited to those about enemies).
It will probably be much faster if you just do it yourself - filter the DLC to Enemies and Battlers and read the product descriptions.
You can probably eliminate some of the 116 just from the thumbnails, either because you don't care for the visual style or because it says it includes characters (although your post is not clear whether you specifically want character sprites
of those monsters
or just some characters to be thrown in).
